parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) NPK fertilisers are used on fields.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Nitrogen and phosphorus are elements contained in NPK fertilisers. Name the other element contained in NPK fertilisers. ..................................................................................................................................... [1]

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Another compound that can be found in fertilisers has the formula Ca 3 P 2 O 8 . Complete Table 5.1 to calculate the relative formula mass of Ca 3 P 2 O 8 . Table 5.1 type of atom number of atoms relative atomic mass calcium 3 40 3 × 40 = 120 phosphorus 31 oxygen 16 relative formula mass = ......................................................... [2]

ms.label: 5(a)(iv)
ms.text:
310 (2 marks)
IF 2 marks not scored allow 1 mark for:
P = (2 × 31 =) 62 OR O = (8 × 16 =) 128 (1)

ms.label: 5(b)
ms.text:
phosphates: deoxygenation (of water) (1)
metal compounds: toxic (1)

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Nitrogen dioxide, NO 2 , is an oxide of nitrogen and an air pollutant.

ms.label: 5(c)(ii)
ms.text:
any two of:
acid rain
(photochemical) smog
respiratory problems
